items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I never saw her, but they tell me she was a knockout

ctx.x: There was a picture of Ada Overton Walker. And it said, Ada Overton Walker was the real queen of Paris.

She was, she really was. She was. They say she -- I never saw her, but they tell me she was a knockout because Miss Williams had pictures all over, naturally, of course. It was Williams and Walker, you know. And let me see. What did I have I wanted to show you? Something I wanted to show you. I brought this letter from the Courier, where the --
Do you -- did that film you did ever show here in this country, the -- that --
